subject: Execution Contract: Client Calling, Gmail Outreach & Deal Closing Engine
body:
OBJECTIVE: Deploy high-velocity cold calling and Google/Gmail outbound email sequences to acquire and close commercial clients.
OUTPUT: Active pipeline tracking, sent outreach sequences, objection-handling execution, and closed pilot agreements documented in `CLIENT_OUTREACH_PLAYBOOK.md`.
TOOLS: Google Workspace/Gmail templates, cold calling frameworks, Vercel product demos.
BOUNDARIES: Convert qualified leads from Phyllis into paying contracts.
